_meta.notes: Schema v3: items split into 'vehicle' and 'equipment' groups via the `group` field on each entry. Per-item `maintenance` block added with at-a-store reference for fuel, oil, sparkPlug, filters, consumables. Confidence convention: each maintenance value tagged 'verified' (manufacturer spec / OEM doc / on-unit sticker), 'inferred' (typical for product line — double-check before ordering), or 'tbd'.
